# Slachta Accounting & Consulting Services LLC

> Slachta Accounting & Consulting Services LLC is a Stillwater, Minnesota-based CPA firm founded in 2005, serving clients nationwide with a concentration in Minnesota and Wisconsin. The firm positions itself as a trusted partner with niche-deep expertise for dentists, service-based businesses (including insurance agencies, attorneys, architects, and specialty healthcare providers), and established entrepreneurs. Beyond outsourced accounting, payroll, and business tax services, Slachta offers ongoing guidance on cash flow, budgeting, KPIs, and retirement plan evaluation — for clients who want more than a tax preparer.
